name: DISABLE BRAVE REWARDS
description: Disables Brave Rewards (BAT/crypto earning system) to reduce background tasks and UI clutter.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\BraveSoftware\Brave' -Name 'BraveRewardsDisabled' -ErrorAction Stop).'BraveRewardsDisabled'; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\BraveSoftware\Brave' -Name 'BraveWalletDisabled' -ErrorAction Stop).'BraveWalletDisabled'; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"
